title: Aao abbas
body:
Aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya hussain, ya hussain..(3)
<<MINI>>
Ya kashif al karbe..Ya akhee abbas..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya abbas, shah abbas, ya abbas
<<MINI>>
Zere khanjar kaha mazloom ne
aao, aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Shimr sar kaatne wala hai..(2)
<<MINI>>
bachao, bachao abbas
Zere khanjar kaha mazloom ne
aao, aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Karb shabbir ke chehre se hatane wale
aye mujhe ranj o musibat se chudane wale
aaj phir farz wahi apna..(2)
nibhao, nibhao abbas
<<MINI>>
Zere khanjar kaha mazloom ne
aao, aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Saamne bachho ke aisa bhi kabhi hota hia
aisi gustakhi ye karta hai ke dil rota hai
shimr se aake meri zulfein..(2)
chhudao, chhudao abbas
<<MINI>>
Zere khanjar kaha mazloom ne
aao, aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kabhi khanjar ye dikhata hai kabhi hasta hai
rakh ke qur'aan pe zaanu ye laee'n baitha hai
kaun hu mai ye ise yaad..(2)
dilao, dilao abbas
<<MINI>>
Zere khanjar kaha mazloom ne
aao, aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Usko karta hu ishare nahi jaati bachhi
minnatein karti hai qatil ki hamari beti
mere pehlu se sakina ko..(2)
uthao, uthao abbas
<<MINI>>
Zere khanjar kaha mazloom ne
aao, aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Do sadaa aaye na maqtal mein meri maa jayi
mujh se is pyaas mein bola nahi jaata bhai
meri awaaz me awaaz..(2)
milao, milao abbas
<<MINI>>
Zere khanjar kaha mazloom ne
aao, aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jeeteji ehle harm jaa'n se guzar jayenge
zibha hote hue dekhenge to marr jayenge
uth ke parda dar e khaima ka..(2)
girao, girao abbas
<<MINI>>
Zere khanjar kaha mazloom ne
aao, aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Sar qalam ho mera mujhko hai gawara bhaiyya
un ko zakhm aaye ye bardasht na hoga bhaiyya
haath garden se meri maa ke..(2)
<<MINI>>
hatao, hatao abbas
Zere khanjar kaha mazloom ne
aao, aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Be rida dasht mein hojaye na meri hamsheer
aakhri baat hai phir kuch na kahega shabbir
le ke zainab ko madine..(2)
chale jao, chale jao abbas
<<MINI>>
Zere khanjar kaha mazloom ne
aao, aao abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Laasha ek neher pe uth'ta tha kabhi girta tha
ibn e zehra jo takallum ye sada deta hai
akhri waqt hai yaseen..(2)
sunao, sunao abbas
<<MINI>>
Zere khanjar kaha mazloom ne
aao, aao abbas
Ya kashif al karbe..Ya akhee abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
